lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
ፍቕርን ሰላምን ተፍሪ’ያ ጾም /2/
ፍጻሜ ዘይብሉ ክሳብ ዘልዓለም /2/
[[/chorus]]

[[highlight]]ናይ ጾም ፍረ ኩላትና ፈሊጥና /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ንጸሎት ንትጋህ ፍረ ከይሓልፈና /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ኣምላኽ ተፈተነ ብርጉም ጸላኢና /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ጾም ንኽምስርት ንድኅነት ሕይወትና /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ኣምላኽ ተሰከመ ሕማም ናትና /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ናይ ሕይወት ማይ ካብ ጎድኑ ሂቡና /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ሕዝብኻ ሓሉ ካብ ክፉእ ፈተና /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ቅዱስ ኣምላኽና ሓይልና ኢኻ /2/[[/highlight]]
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
Fiqhrin selamn tefri’ya tsom /2/
Fitsame zeybilu kisab zelʿalem /2/
[[/chorus]]

[[highlight]]Nay tsom fre kulatna felit'na /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Nitselot nitgah fre keyhalfena /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ʾAmlakh tefetene birgum tselaʾina /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Tsom nikhmisrit nidhinet hiywetna /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ʾAmlakh tesekeme himam natna /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Nay hiywet may kab godnu hibuna /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]Hizbikha halu kab kifuʾi fetena /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Qidus ʾamlakhna haylina ʾikha /2/[[/highlight]]
